data.reason: The R006 proposed E2 exclusion and later 05:32 UTC nonblinded AI recheck were independently source-inspected for integration on 10 Nov 2026 using the original publisher's PDF pages 4–5. Materials and Methods identifies 15 decontextualized interview-derived clips (five across Watson, Sophia and human voices); Procedure instructs listeners to rate voice/speaker first impressions, not to receive operational machine/task status or obey system-issued action cues. The seemingly imperative Facebook phrase and robot-persona statements were assessed as contrary cases, but they are quoted interview stimuli rather than current task-action messages. Thus frozen G01/E2 fails for this Track E report; Track G interest in voice affect remains. The original preliminary and later checks were AI, not independent human screening; current registrar is an integration source reviewer, not the original assessor. Revisit if original text or stimuli establish a genuinely task-coupled machine message. No independent sample, experiment, outcomes or numerical finding admitted.
